glossary.title: Help & Glossary
glossary.MCA: Modified Class Average. The class average after the highest and lowest outliers are set aside, which the university calculates using the interquartile range method.
glossary.CLO: Course Learning Outcome. What a single course is meant to teach you, stated as something you can do by the end of it.
glossary.PLO: Programme Learning Outcome. What your whole degree is meant to teach you. Each CLO feeds into one or more of these.
glossary.CrAtt: Credits Attempted. The total credit hours of the courses you registered for.
glossary.CrErnd: Credits Earned. The credit hours you actually passed. A failed course is attempted but not earned.
glossary.ARN: Admission Reference Number. The number assigned when you were admitted, separate from your roll number.
glossary.Challan: A payment voucher. It carries the amount, the due date and a number you quote when paying at a bank or through an app.
glossary.SGPA: Semester Grade Point Average. Your average for one semester only.
glossary.CGPA: Cumulative Grade Point Average. Your average across every semester so far.
glossary.headroom: How many more classes you can miss in a course before falling below the attendance requirement.
